note: Central/East Africa, c. 1990s (Rwandan genocide era and similar Great Lakes region topics). "populated": true means these backdrops already have their people drawn in by Firefly, in the same generation as the scene -- no separate character sheets, no sprite cutouts, no Python-side compositing or idle-bob animation. Deliberately does not attempt to visually distinguish Hutu from Tutsi -- that classification was colonial-era and administrative, not a reliable physical distinction, and depicting it as one would reproduce a harmful stereotype. Violence is kept off-screen throughout (aftermath/mood only, no depicted harm).
